tasks.goal: Guide stewards along the Charter Hall exhibits, gesturing at each charter panel and narrating the contribution model.
tasks.terrain: Sloping hilltop terrace of Piazzale Michelangelo; smooth stone paving with tourists, low exhibit plinths and balustrade edges to avoid.
success: Visits all 5 exhibit waypoints in order
Maintains >=0.5 m clearance from plinths
Speech segment per exhibit completes before moving on
safety_stops: E-stop on human within 0.3 m
Stop if localization covariance exceeds 0.5 m
Kneel and pause on battery below 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the final tour script and pacing before public sessions.

tasks.goal: Patrol lab benches carrying printed research digests to each synthesis workstation on schedule.
tasks.terrain: Indoor lab flooring with cable runs, chair legs and rolling carts between workstations; doorway thresholds.
success: Delivers digest to each of 4 stations
Zero collisions (contact force threshold 0 N)
Completes round within 10 min
safety_stops: Stop on obstacle <0.4 m from lidar
Stop on tilt >20 deg
Abort delivery if station occupant not confirmed
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms receipt at each station and flags misfiled digests.

tasks.goal: Escort stewards between debate pods and the voting booth area, displaying active proposal summaries on body screen.
tasks.terrain: Open forum floor with tiered seating steps, podium steps and grouped seating pods; uneven stone-look flooring at terrace threshold.
success: Maintains 1 m escort offset from lead steward
No step-edge violations (kerb detector silent)
Proposal summary updates within 5 s of topic change
safety_stops: Sit down if steward signal lost >3 s
Refuse stair descent without operator override
Stop on any human within 0.5 m in path
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward triggers each escort leg and can halt the robot verbally at any time.

tasks.goal: Restock task-routing consumables (printed task cards, name badges) from supply crate to deck organizer slots.
tasks.terrain: Fixed deck workstation; crate on table with badge holders and card stacks; cable-free clear table surface but varying card stack heights.
success: Picks and places 12 items with >=95% placement accuracy
Gripper force within 20-40 N band
Zero dropped items
safety_stops: Stop if external wrench >60 N
Pause on human hand in workspace via camera
Halt if any joint exceeds velocity limit 150%
tasks.human_in_loop: Deck operator confirms the pick list and signs off completed restock.

tasks.goal: Map the Progress Observatory gallery and record QR-tagged outcome boards into the metric map for progress dashboards.
tasks.terrain: Wide gallery aisles on hilltop terrace level; occasional rain-slick stone at open edge, display plinths and stanchion ropes.
success: Coverage >=90% of walkable aisle area
Detects and georeferences all QR boards (>=8)
Map drift <0.2 m over loop closure
safety_stops: Stop on slope >15 deg
Stop at terrace edge marker line
Pause in heavy rain per weather topic
tasks.human_in_loop: Curator verifies georeferenced board IDs before dashboard publication.

tasks.goal: Fly a lawnmower-pattern scan above the terrace capturing panorama imagery linking DAO zones to the Florence skyline context.
tasks.terrain: Open-air hilltop terrace ~100 m above the Arno; gusty mediterranean wind, cypress trees, balustrade and monument flags as obstructions.
success: Completes full grid pattern within 12 min
Position tracking error <0.3 m RMS
Imagery covers all 5 zone entry points
safety_stops: Land immediately if wind >8 m/s
Return-to-home on battery <3.7 V
Avoid no-fly cylinder around monument flagpole
tasks.human_in_loop: Safety pilot approves flight plan and can trigger manual RTH at any time.

tasks.goal: Demonstrate collaborative drafting by physically sorting proposal cards into 'for-debate' and 'needs-revision' trays during forum sessions.
tasks.terrain: Forum table surface with card stacks, tray dividers and occasional reaching hands from seated participants.
success: Sorts >=10 cards with >=90% correct tray
Impedance-mode contact forces <10 N
Zero hard collisions with hands (reflex triggers count)
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact >10 N
Pause when hand detected within 15 cm of gripper
Stop if joint torque limit reached
tasks.human_in_loop: Participants may override any card's sort decision; moderator confirms session end state.
